## Working with w_tools (for humans and AI)

1. **Get facts first**: `dart run w_tools_cli:context --format=prompt`
   (installed versions, toolkit exports, checks to run)
2. **Reuse before writing**: `dart run w_tools_cli:list <keyword>`,
   then `dart run w_tools_cli:explain <Component>`; **do not invent component names**.
   Business code imports `package:{{app}}/app/w/toolkit.dart` only.
3. **If missing, stage it** in `lib/app/design_system/` (do not modify w_tools directly):
   - imports: `dart:*` / `package:flutter*` / `package:w_tools*` / `package:get`
   - header `// STAGED: move to w_tools_ui`, plus measured design specs
   - at least one test; maintainers decide promotion (second use case / release window)
4. Business layer keeps feature-specific composition only.
5. **Page shell**: standard pages default to `AppScaffold`
   (`lib/app/ui/app_scaffold.dart`); do not use `WScaffold` / `WAppBar` directly.
   Use `AppScaffold(appBar: WAppBar(...))` for a custom app bar; use `WScaffold` or plain
   `Scaffold` for drawers/bottom sheets/non-standard safe areas, and note why in the PR.
   Change app-bar defaults only in `AppBars.style`.
   **Bottom navigation**: use `WNavBar` + `WNavController`; `WNavController` needs `vsync`,
   is created in the page State and disposed there; use `WTabBar` for top tabs. It requires
   `TabController` / `DefaultTabController` and does not own one. Do not hand-roll `BottomNavigationBar`.
   **Buttons** use `AppButtons.primary/secondary/text/danger(context)`; do not write
   `WButtonStyle` in pages unless it is an explicit one-off style.
   **Use `WButton` for real buttons and `WPressable` for arbitrary cards/child taps**;
   use `WFormButton` for form-field value selection; do not wrap arbitrary children with `WButton`.
   **Button width**: `WButtonSize` / `WButtonStyle` do not contain `width`; use
   `SizedBox(width: double.infinity)` or `Expanded` to fill, and an outer `SizedBox` for fixed width.
   `WButton` has no `variant`; use `style`; do not pass both `label` and `content`.
   With `loading`, also set `enabled: !loading`; provide `semanticLabel` for icon-only buttons.
   Put state colors (disabled / pressed / hovered / focused) in `AppButtons`; set
   `disabledOpacity: 1` when explicit disabled colors are used.
<!-- @optional:form:start -->
   **Forms**: when `w_tools_form` is enabled, use `WForm` + direct fields
   (`WFormTextField`, etc.); do not start from `Config.build`. `WForm` requires a
   `WFormController` (one-to-one); use `WForm.fieldStyle` for page-level height/padding
   and `WFormValidatorSettings` for validation; use field `config` for special styling.
<!-- @optional:form:end -->
   **Images**: use `WImage.network` for network images and
   `WImage.asset(name, prefix: true)` for assets; use `WImageStyle` for visuals and
   `WImageConfig` for loading/retry/placeholders. Do not use `Image.network` / `Image.asset` directly.
<!-- @optional:form:start -->
   **Form overlays**: use `WFormPopup` for anchored selection.
<!-- @optional:form:end -->
<!-- @optional:app:start -->
   **Bottom sheet**: use `WBottomSheet`.
<!-- @optional:app:end -->
<!-- @optional:toast:start -->
   **Light feedback**: use `WToast`.
<!-- @optional:toast:end -->
   Use Flutter `showDialog` for confirmation.
   **Text**: use `WText(variant: WTextVariant.xxx)` + `WTextStyles`; keep fonts/sizes/line heights
   in the theme, `WTextConfig` has been removed; do not build styles field-by-field. Override with `style` / `color` /
   `maxLines` / `overflow` locally.
   Minimal example: `WText(text: 'Title', variant: WTextVariant.title)`.
   Reuse existing variants first (including `price` / `number` / `badge`). If a variant is not
   enough: use `variant + style` for one-offs; extract a local helper for repeated project styles.
   Consumers cannot add `WTextVariant` enum values; propose a library variant only for stable
   cross-page semantics.
   **Extensions**: use `toThousandsSeparated` / `toCurrency` / `toPercent` for number formatting;
   `HexColor.fromHex` or `'#rrggbb'.toColor()` for colors; use `num.allPadding` for `EdgeInsets` values;
   compose `BoxDecoration` with `withColor` / `withBorderRadius` / `withShadow`.
   **Tools**: use `WScreen.w/h/sp` for screen/font adaptation and `WAssets.imagePath`
   for asset prefixes; use `WSizeBox` for `SizedBox`, `WPadding` for `Padding`, and `num.allPadding`
   when an `EdgeInsets` value is required. Do not use `num.heightBox` / `widthBox` / `squareBox`;
   they duplicate `WSizeBox` and remain only for compatibility.
   `WColumn.left/right` / `WRow.top/bottom` default to `MainAxisSize.max`; pass `MainAxisSize.min` to wrap content.
   **Lists / notifications**: use `WKeepAliveWrapper` for list-item keep-alive and
   `WNotificationListenerBuilder` for scroll notifications/percentage (only depth 0 `ScrollUpdateNotification`).
   **Init timing**: never call `.sp` in `main` / top-level finals. Build `WTextStyles` with `.sp`
   in `ScreenUtilInit.builder` / `WAppPlugin.builderWrapper`; `wrapApp` has no Theme,
   so theme-aware typography must use `builderWrapper`.
   **Boxes**: put repeated `BoxDecoration` values in `AppBoxes`; use `AppCard` for repeated
   cards; use `Container` + `BoxDecoration` for one-off boxes; use `Container` directly
   for width/height/constraints/transform. Do not add an `AppBox` / `AppContainer` god wrapper.
<!-- @optional:async:start -->
   **Async blocks**: with `w_tools_async`, use `WAsyncController + WAsyncView` for pages;
   do not hand-write `ValueNotifier<WAsyncState>` or repeat `when + RetryView` per page.
   One Controller per independent block; use `WAsyncViewDefaults` for global defaults
   at the app root (`WAppPlugin.wrapApp` / `WApp.appWrapper`), not only inside `AppScaffold.body`.
   Use `WAsyncView` for normal blocks; use `WAsyncStateBuilder` for scroll pages /
   `SmartRefresher`, never wrap `SmartRefresher` around `WAsyncView`; keep pagination local.
   `WAsyncStateBuilder.builder` must always return the same `SmartRefresher + CustomScrollView`;
   put loading/empty/error inside slivers, never switch the outer scroll shell.
   `WAsyncViewDefaults` applies to `WAsyncView` only; use `WAsyncSliverDefaults` for slivers.
   Its loading/empty/error builders must be non-scrollable; `refreshingSliverBuilder` must return a sliver.
   `WAsyncBuilder` is a compatibility alias; use `WAsyncStateBuilder` in new code.
   Use `WAsyncStateSliver` for four-state slivers; `readySliverBuilder` must return a sliver.
   It adds no refreshing indicator by default; let SmartRefresher own refresh feedback.
<!-- @optional:async:end -->
<!-- @optional:api:start -->
   **Network**: with `w_tools_api`, use `WApiConfig` + `DioRegistry.forBaseUrl`, never
   `Dio()` directly; initialize each baseUrl once. Store tokens with `w_tools_core`'s
   `WToken` and inject via `WTokenInterceptor` (`tokenGetter` / `tokenClearer` /
   `tokenRefresher`); 401 retry depends on DioRegistry. Use `WLogInterceptor` for logs;
   sensitive headers are redacted by default.
<!-- @optional:api:end -->
<!-- @optional:app:start -->
   **Startup**: use `WApp.start()` as the entry point, not a hand-written runApp/init
   sequence; declare plugin order with `WAppPlugin.dependsOn`. `builderWrapper` lives
   inside MaterialApp; `wrapApp` is outside and has no Theme/MediaQuery. `WRouteObserver`
   is appended by WApp automatically; do not add it twice.
<!-- @optional:app:end -->
   **Core utilities**: call `await WStorage.init()` before reads; `WStorage` / `WToken`
   are plaintext storage. Use `WValidator` for semantic validation and `WRegExp` for
   pure regex; log through `WLogger`.
   **Scanning**: use `WQrView`, not the raw `QRView`; `scanOnce` defaults to true, <!-- @optional:qr -->
   and restart via `GlobalKey<WQrViewState>.restartScan()`. <!-- @optional:qr -->
   **Maps**: use `WMap` + `WMapZone`, not raw `GoogleMap`; marker ids must be stable, <!-- @optional:map -->
   and `json_serializable` models should use `WMapItemMapper`; API key required. <!-- @optional:map -->
6. **Hard rules**: depend on subpackages, never the aggregate `w_tools`;
   business code imports only the toolkit entry, never `package:w_tools_*` directly.
7. **Before done**:
   - `dart run w_tools_cli:doctor --json` → 0 error
   - `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`
<!-- w_tools:end -->
